<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ui_page"><sys_ui_page action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>general</category><client_script/><description/><direct>false</direct><endpoint>x_1108048_wish_l_0_case_list_with_custom_search.do</endpoint><html><?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<j:jelly trim="false" xmlns:j="jelly:core" xmlns:g="glide" xmlns:j2="null" xmlns:g2="null">
  
  <!-- 上部：自定义检索区块 -->
  <div class="panel panel-default" style="margin-bottom: 20px;">
    <div class="panel-heading">
      <h3 class="panel-title">🔍 快速检索</h3>
    </div>
    <div class="panel-body">
      <div class="form-group">
        <input 
          type="text" 
          class="form-control" 
          id="customSearchInput" 
          placeholder="输入编号、描述等关键词..." 
          onkeyup="performCustomSearch(this.value)"
          style="max-width: 400px;"
        />
        <small class="text-muted">实时搜索，输入后自动显示结果</small>
      </div>
      
      <!-- 自定义搜索结果 -->
      <div id="customSearchResults">
        <p class="text-muted">请输入搜索关键词...</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 下部：保留原有的记录列表 -->
  <div class="panel panel-default">
    <div class="panel-heading">
      <h3 class="panel-title">📋 所有记录列表</h3>
    </div>
    <div class="panel-body">
      <!-- 嵌入标准的列表视图 -->
      <g2:evaluate var="jvar_table" expression="'incident'"/>
      <g2:inline list="true" table="incident"/>
    </div>
  </div>

<script>
<![CDATA[
    // 自定义搜索函数
    function performCustomSearch(keyword) {
      if (!keyword || keyword.length < 2) {
        document.getElementById('customSearchResults').innerHTML = '<p class="text-muted">请输入搜索关键词...</p>';
        return;
      }

      var ga = new GlideAjax('GlobalClientServerUtils');
      ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'searchRecords');
      ga.addParam('sysparm_keyword', keyword);
      ga.addParam('sysparm_table', 'incident');
      ga.getXML(handleCustomSearchResponse);
    }

    function handleCustomSearchResponse(response) {
      var answer = response.responseXML.documentElement.getAttribute("answer");
      var results = JSON.parse(answer);
      var resultsHtml = '';

      if (results.length > 0) {
        resultsHtml += '<div class="search-results-container">';
        resultsHtml += '<p class="text-success"><strong>找到 ' + results.length + ' 条结果:</strong></p>';
        resultsHtml += '<div class="list-group">';
        
        for (var i = 0; i < results.length; i++) {
          var item = results[i];
          var description = item.short_description || '无描述';
          var state = item.state || 'N/A';
          
          resultsHtml += '<a href="incident.do?sys_id=' + item.sys_id + '" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action">';
          resultsHtml += '<div class="d-flex w-100 justify-content-between">';
          resultsHtml += '<h5 class="mb-1">' + item.number + '</h5>';
          resultsHtml += '<small>点击查看</small>';
          resultsHtml += '</div>';
          resultsHtml += '<p class="mb-1">' + description + '</p>';
          resultsHtml += '<small>状态: ' + state + '</small>';
          resultsHtml += '</a>';
        }
        
        resultsHtml += '</div></div>';
      } else {
        resultsHtml = '<p class="text-warning">未找到匹配的结果。</p>';
      }

      document.getElementById('customSearchResults').innerHTML = resultsHtml;
    }
]]>
</script>

  <style>
    .search-results-container {
      max-height: 400px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      margin-top: 15px;
    }
    .list-group-item {
      border-left: 4px solid #007eff;
    }
  </style>
